attchmntText: Niraj Cement Structurals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Niraj Cement Structurals Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified review report. For the half year ended 30th September, 2026, the company reported revenue from operations of 30,542.37 Lakhs and a profit after tax of 1,251.36 Lakhs. Earnings per share were 2.10. Total assets stood at 49,955.32 Lakhs as of 30th September, 2026, compared to 45,987.25 Lakhs on 31st March, 2026. The company noted that it challenged search proceedings by the DGGI and deposited Rs. 100.40 Lakhs as under protest. The matter is sub-judice in the Gujarat High Court.
